source: CONTRACTS.md §1.4 (engine rules), R3.1 (protocol.*, aesi.clock_started and tier.protocol_floor rules from the EMPOWER-Lung 1 protocol tables protocol_rules.json / irae_mapping.json) and R2.4 (chartscan.* rules of the chart-note scanner ported from omer-khawar/ae-checkin-agent, Omer Khawar, MIT). Every rule id the engine or the scanner can emit is listed here; eval personas reference these ids.
rationale: A closed catalog lets the dashboard, the eval harness and the audit log agree on rule identity. description_template documents the plain-English sentence each rule produces (placeholders in braces are substituted with the actual values at run time). Per-item rules (score.composite.*, grade.provisional.*) are listed once per shipped item so the catalog is exhaustive without wildcards.

rules.description_template: Vitals: no samples were captured for this session; check-in evaluated without vitals
Vitals: {n} sample(s) captured but no metric reached confidence {min_confidence} with a valid averaging window ({n_low} low-confidence, {n_short} window-too-short reading(s)); vitals ignored

rules.description_template: {aedecod} reported again {days_since} day(s) after open AE {ae_open_id} (within {window_days}-day window) -> follow-up, no new AE
{aedecod}: no open AE within {window_days} days -> new AE
rules.emitted_when: no eligible open AE within window (an open AE last reported by this same session, or dated more than max_future_skew_s after this check-in, is skipped and listed in inputs.open_aes_skipped)

rules.description_template: AE draft {aeseq}: {aedecod}, provisional grade {grade}{followup_note}
VS draft {vstestcd}: {vsorres} {vsorresu} ({vsmethod}, n={n_samples})
CM draft: '{cmtrt}' -> {cmdecod} ({match_kind}, confidence {confidence})

Possible adverse event of special interest (possible AESI, investigator to confirm): {labels}. {label}: provisional grade {grade} (provisional, investigator to confirm) on a potentially immune-related item ({irae_category}). Protocol §9.4.3, p. 92 lists '{criterion}'. The protocol asks for AESI reports within 24 hours of identification.
rules.emitted_when: a provisional grade >= 3 on an item irae_mapping.json marks potentially immune-related, or grade >= 1 on such an item when protocol_context.prior_pi3k_inhibitor is true (protocol_rules.json aesi.criteria); never changes a grade or the tier

rules.description_template: 24-hour AESI clock started (possible AESI, investigator to confirm). The site became aware at {site_awareness_at}; the report to the sponsor is due {due_at} (24 h, protocol §9.4.3, p. 92: same process as an SAE report)
rules.emitted_when: protocol.aesi_suspected fired; CheckInResult.aesi_clock has kind 'aesi', due = completed_at + protocol_rules.json aesi.reporting_hours

rules.description_template: No second AESI clock for {label} (open AE {ae_open_id}) (possible AESI, investigator to confirm): this check-in is a follow-up of an open AE that already has a 24-hour AESI clock, so the existing clock stands (one event, one clock)
rules.emitted_when: protocol.aesi_suspected fired and a suspected item is a dedup follow-up of an OpenAE with aesi_clock_started = true; when every suspected item is covered, CheckInResult.aesi_clock is null

rules.description_template: Medication '{verbatim}' is {drug}, which the protocol does not allow (§7.7.1, p. 69: '{quote}'). Possible protocol deviation, coordinator to confirm; tier floor 2
rules.emitted_when: the reported medication matches protocol_rules.json conmeds.prohibited by medlist match or by a whole word/phrase of the verbatim text (any direction: a stopped prohibited drug was still taken during the study)

rules.description_template: Medication '{verbatim}' is {drug}, a systemic corticosteroid the protocol recommends avoiding (§7.7.2, p. 69) '{exception_text}' Coordinator to check the reason with the study team; tier unchanged
rules.emitted_when: the reported medication matches conmeds.discouraged and the text has no non-systemic qualifier (cream, ointment, drops, inhaler ...)

rules.description_template: Medication '{verbatim}' is {drug}, which the protocol permits (§7.7.2, p. 69: '{quote}'). Condition: '{condition}'. No protocol issue; tier unchanged

The protocol asks for each medication's generic name, dose, dose unit, frequency, indication and start/stop date (§7.7, p. 69). Still missing for '{verbatim}': {missing}. Coordinator to ask the participant
rules.emitted_when: a medication change was reported; lists the protocol_rules.json cm_required_fields a kiosk CM draft cannot fill (INTERIM_CM_MISSING_FIELDS)

rules.description_template: Chart note: '{quote}' -> {term}, provisional grade hint {grade_hint} ({grade_basis}); onset {onset_days} day(s) before the note; worsening; resolved per the text
rules.emitted_when: one per kept symptom finding of a scanned chart note (interim_rules.chartscan.rules_fired); the API drafts an AE with AEDECOD = term, AETOXGR = grade hint (never above composite_to_grade.max_assignable_grade), INTERIM_SOURCE = chart_note; inputs.resolved = true when the text says the symptom resolved (the API may propose AEENDTC)

rules.description_template: Chart note: '{quote}' ({term}) skipped: {excluded_reason}: {reason}
rules.emitted_when: one per excluded symptom mention (negated, historical, hypothetical); no draft

rules.description_template: Chart note: '{quote}' -> {drug} ({change}): {reason}
rules.emitted_when: one per kept medication finding; the API drafts a CM with CMTRT = quote, CMDECOD = drug, CMSTDTC/CMENDTC from change

rules.description_template: Chart note: '{quote}' ({drug}) skipped: {excluded_reason} ({reason})
rules.emitted_when: one per excluded medication mention (allergy, negated); no draft

rules.description_template: Chart note red flag ({level}, {category}): {reason} -- '{quote}'
rules.emitted_when: one per red-flag category matched (first non-excluded match); a note escalates to Tier 2 at most and never pages or shows a stop screen (D-017)

rules.description_template: Chart note mentions hospitalization or an ER visit ('{quote}') -> seriousness suspected (ICH E2A); the SAE clock starts when the site reads the note
rules.emitted_when: a red flag of a seriousness category (hospitalization) fired; the API sets seriousness_suspected and starts the SAE clock with site_awareness_at = ingested_at
